jobs.job: Trends-only quick check, capped at 5 minutes: find what is rising on TikTok today for the shop account (trending sounds, hashtags, top videos in the category) and put real, named, dated findings on the run. Do not page the showcase. Bring the one story sentence on a 'Story:' line: who this is for and why they'd care, in Glam's voice, the way she'd say it to a friend. No sentence, no handoff.
needs: the farm's TikTok browser (Glam keeps it signed in) to read today's trends
an AI model (Claude, Muse/Indigo or another assigned agent) to do the writing — the runner itself never writes
sent_back: scout findings on file but the story sentence does not pass — no 'Story:' line in scout.md. The Scout does not hand off without one real sentence in Glam's voice: who this is for and why they'd care (a 'Story:' line in steps/step2-scout/scout.md)

jobs.job: Read the script against the farm laws and the real listing photo. Place your verdict ONLY by running the Mila sign workflow (mila-sign.yml) with run <run>, step 6, verdict APPROVE or SENDBACK, notes listing every fix, and your own session id; it signs with the key only it holds and approves or sends back to the Story Agent. Your approval covers this exact script; the Casting / Image Agent starts the moment you approve. Glam is not asked; she rules once, on the finished video.
needs: Mila (an AI agent) to read the script against the farm laws

jobs.job: Write the real-UGC pain-point script INSIDE the farm, built from the Scout's story sentence and the product's approved selling points (farm-data/products/<listing id>/selling-points.md). Check the angle log (farm-data/angle-log.json) so this product's angle and hook don't repeat, and record this video's angle and hook there. Spoken lines go on LINE rows in quotes; add the 'CTA:' line for the soft CTA up top. The script check runs the moment you submit; a failing script comes straight back to you. Then Mila approves with her signed verdict file the exact script (or sends it back with notes).
needs: an AI model (Claude, Muse/Indigo or another assigned agent) to do the writing — the runner itself never writes
sent_back: script line 5 sets up a before-and-after ('before/after') — never, for any product
script line 11 (CTA/caption) makes a banned health/beauty claim ('hair growth') — never on screen or in the caption, even if the listing says it
